test_stringify_path_pathlib: test the pandas.io.common stringify_path function handles pathlib.Path objects correctly
test_stringify_path_fspath: test the pandas.io.common stringify_path function handles __fspath__ protocol objects
test_infer_compression_from_path: test the pandas.io.common infer_compression function detects compression from file extension
test_get_handle_with_path: test the pandas.io.common get_handle function expands user home directory in paths
test_get_handle_with_buffer: test the pandas.io.common get_handle function manages StringIO buffer lifecycle
test_bytesiowrapper_returns_correct_byte: test the pandas.io.common get_handle returns correct byte counts for multi-byte characters
test_is_fsspec_url: test the pandas.io.common is_fsspec_url function identifies fsspec-compatible remote URLs
test_is_fsspec_url_chained: test the pandas.io.common is_fsspec_url function supports chained fsspec URLs
test_read_fspath_all: test pandas readers accept __fspath__ protocol objects as file paths
test_write_fspath_all: test pandas DataFrame writers accept __fspath__ protocol objects as file paths
test_read_non_existent: test pandas readers raise FileNotFoundError for missing files
test_write_missing_parent_directory: test pandas DataFrame writers raise OSError when parent directory does not exist
test_mmap_wrapper_next: test the pandas.io.common get_handle with memory_map=True iterates over memory-mapped file lines
test_warning_missing_utf_bom: test pandas CSV writer warns and reader fails for bz2/xz compressed UTF-16/32 without BOM
test_encoding_errors: test pandas readers handle encoding_errors parameter with strict and replace modes
